final.role: Obsidian plugin for semantic note search and related-note discovery using local embeddings.
final.evidence: README: uses local embeddings to surface semantically related notes; Lookup view for semantic search; private and offline by default; works on mobile; Pro features exist.

conferencia.nota: Obsidian-side semantic search with a built-in local model; helps humans in Obsidian, but README shows no MCP or agent access.
